notes:
Sources used: QSC's official PLD Series spec sheet PDF (https://www.qscaudio.com/resource-files/productresources/amp/pld/q_amp_pld_specs.pdf, "PLD Spec Sheet 09/19/16") and the official QSC PLD user manual PDF (https://www.qscaudio.com/resource-files/productresources/amp/pld/q_amp_pld_usermanual.pdf, TD-000368-00-A), both linked from QSC's current discontinued-products page (https://www.qscaudio.com/live-sound/support/discontinued-products/amplifiers) — PLD4.3 is now End-of-Service/discontinued but the documentation is complete and unambiguous.

Physical I/O confirmed from the manual's rear-panel diagram/legend: "1. USB Type B, 4-Pin; 2. Four XLR-F Female Line Input Connectors; 3. Four XLR-M Male Line Output Connectors; 4. Four NL4 Output Connectors (Individual and Parallel); 5. Two NL4 Output Connectors (Bridged Outputs); ... 8. Locking IEC Power Connection (100-240 VAC, 50-60 Hz)." Input channels are labeled 1-4 ("Four XLR jacks labeled 1 to 4... audio inputs"); output/speaker channels are labeled A, B, C, D ("Output channels are labeled A, B, C, and D"; default routing "Input 1 to Output A, 2 to B, 3 to C, and 4 to D"); the two bridged NL4 jacks are labeled X and Y on the rear-panel silkscreen diagram (A+B bridge → X, C+D bridge → Y).

No Ethernet/network port exists on the PLD series (unlike QSC's higher-tier CXD/Q-SYS amplifiers) — control is local front panel or via the USB port and QSC's Amplifier Navigator desktop app.

No connector grades apply: XLR/Speakon/IEC are not in the graded connector families, and the manual does not state a USB spec version for the USB-B port, so grade is omitted everywhere per instructions.

Dimensions 3.5" x 19" x 16" confirm 2 rack units (RU); QSC's own marketing copy states "just 2RU." Weight 21.0 lb (9.5 kg) net. AC input is a universal 100-240 VAC 50-60 Hz switchmode supply with PFC; the "locking IEC" inlet uses a proprietary retention collar over a standard IEC C13/C14-shaped connector (ships with a locking IEC cable) — mapped to the closest taxonomy id "iec" since no dedicated locking-IEC id exists.
